description: This file contains unit tests for the functions related to internationalization provider and model selection (docsPiProvider and docsPiModel). The tests verify environment variable logic determining the provider and model used in documentation internationalization.

methods.name: TestDocsPiProviderPrefersExplicitOverride
methods.description: Tests that the provider prioritized environment variable overrides correctly.

methods.name: TestDocsPiProviderPrefersOpenAIEnvWhenAvailable
methods.description: Tests fallback logic to OpenAI environment variable when no explicit provider is set.

methods.name: TestDocsPiModelUsesProviderDefault
methods.description: Verifies that the default model aligns with the selected provider when no explicit model override is given.

methods.name: TestDocsPiModelKeepsOpenAIDefaultAtGPT54
methods.description: Checks that the OpenAI default model is used when provider is openai with no explicit override.

methods.name: TestDocsPiModelPrefersExplicitOverride
methods.description: Ensures explicit model override is respected over environment defaults.
